call_purpose: You wanted help with lesson videos in your course that keep loading and never play for your students, mostly on their phones, and you hoped it gets sorted out.
objective: Get the course lesson videos playing for your students.

covered.text: We opened the affected lesson on desktop Chrome, Safari and a phone, and the video played fine each time, so we could not reproduce the problem from our side. This issue is not resolved yet.

customer_next_steps.text: Ask one of the affected students to record a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link.

support_next_steps.text: Our team will raise the video loading problem with our technical team and get back to you. We could not give a timeline during the call.
